name: Anomaly Detector
description: Detects statistically significant anomalies and concerning trends in operational metrics

capabilities.name: Z-Score Anomaly Detection
capabilities.description: Calculate z-scores against 4-week rolling average to identify > 2-sigma deviations

capabilities.name: Trend Analysis
capabilities.description: Detect concerning trends (3+ weeks consecutive decline) and positive breakouts

capabilities.name: Severity Classification
capabilities.description: Classify anomalies as critical, warning, or info based on impact and metric importance

capabilities.name: Escalation Routing
capabilities.description: Identify anomalies requiring immediate escalation based on criticality

capabilities.name: Recommendation Generation
capabilities.description: Generate investigation and remediation recommendations for each anomaly

capabilities.name: Context-Aware Analysis
capabilities.description: Adjust sensitivity based on health score context and known events

capabilities.name: False Positive Filtering
capabilities.description: Reduce false positives from normal metric volatility

constraints.description: Z-score > 2.0 required for statistical anomaly flag
Require 2+ historical snapshots for trend analysis
Flag > 30% week-over-week change as automatic anomaly
